text: MoA+ Project Mode 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web，为项目会话提供持久协调者、可复用工作者和共享上下文。协调者通过 control_workers 分派任务、查看状态与历史，并可立即引导或排队发送后续指令；工作者完成回合后会返回结果供协调者审阅。插件还提供工作者时间线、侧栏分支、项目面板，以及可渐进读取的项目知识索引。适合需要跨任务组织多个 agent 的开发项目。运行需兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 的 Project Mode 扩展，且声明 Node.js 24.9 或以上。

MoA+ Project Mode adds coordination to DeepSeek Harness Web. A Coordinator assigns tasks to reusable Workers, tracks progress, and reviews results. Agents share project knowledge, and a timeline shows Worker activity. For multi-agent projects; requires compatible DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 extensions.
我想让主 agent 把项目任务分配给多个工作者并持续跟进。
怎么让子 agent 可以重复使用，并接着之前的工作继续做？
我希望给正在工作的 agent 追加指令，或者留到它下一轮再执行。
想查看工作者最近的输入和回答，必要时打开完整历史。
能不能让协调者和工作者共用项目笔记与可复用知识？
我需要查看工作者状态，并能中断或移除不再需要的工作者。
I want a coordinator to delegate project tasks and review reusable workers' results.
How can agents share project notes while I inspect their work histories in the interface?
MoA+ 工作者管理：协调者调用 control_workers 创建、列出、查看、继续、打断或删除工作者；后续消息可立即生效，也可排进下一轮，并能分页查询历史。
MoA+ 共享项目记忆：协调者和工作者通过 context.md 索引维护可复用资料，按任务逐步读取相关文件；协调者同时维护项目进度与归档记录。
MoA+ 工作者时间线：项目面板展示所选工作者的近期工作记录，支持展开消息查看完整 Markdown，并请求加载更早的历史内容。
MoA+ 项目模式切换：用户可在普通会话中启用 Project 模式，插件为会话建立项目身份并维护模式状态，客户端提供相应的项目入口。
MoA+ 初始化要求 DSH tools 服务具备 suppress 能力，源码将缺少该能力视为需要 Project Mode 原生兼容扩展。

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Core capabilities：Project Mode gives the coordination work of a multi-Agent project to a persistent Coordinator in the main conversation. You set the goal; it chooses Workers, follows their progress, reviews results and keeps project knowledge useful across tasks.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Core capabilities：| Capability | What it gives you |
| --- | --- |
| Persistent coordination | One Coordinator conversation owns the project's work records and next steps. |
| Full Worker control | Create or reuse Workers, steer current work, queue later instructions, inspect status and history, interrupt or delete. |
| Shared project knowledge | Coordinator and Workers maintain an index and load relevant context progressively. |
| Automatic result return | Each ended Worker turn returns its full final AI message for Coordinator review. |
| Direct human participation | Open a Worker, guide it yourself, then return to the Coordinator. |
| Native DSH execution | Sessions, Agent Loop, tools, permissions, message delivery and Stop stay with DSH. |

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Quick start：The easiest first run is a separate **compatible DSH Web environment**. Requires Node **24.9+**, npm and Git:

```sh
git clone --branch v0.1.23 https://github.com/Burns1028/dsh-plugin-project-mode.git
cd dsh-plugin-project-mode
node scripts/project-mode.mjs setup
node scripts/project-mode.mjs start

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Quick start：Setup installs the locked rc.3 runtime and applies exactly the three reviewed extensions inside `~/.dsh-project-mode/rc3`. Your ordinary Desktop app, `~/.dsh`, global Agent configuration and workspaces are not reused. The native Web UI opens locally; configure your model, create a conversation and select **Project** before its first message.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Quick start：Use `node scripts/project-mode.mjs doctor` to check the prepared environment. See the [first-run guide](docs/quickstart.md) for locations, restart and recovery, and try the [reproducible project task](docs/demo-workflow.md).

For an already prepared compatible Desktop/runtime, the plugin can still be installed through its native CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/Burns1028/dsh-plugin-project-mode.git#v0.1.23"
```

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Quick start：Stock rc.3 remains incompatible. The setup script is explicit, not an npm installation hook, and does not patch an existing Desktop app. [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md) documents the three native extensions and manual route; tagged bundles are on [Releases](https://github.com/Burns1028/dsh-plugin-project-mode/releases).

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · User guide：| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| You | Set goals, make decisions and talk to the Coordinator. You can also open a Worker and guide it directly. |
| Coordinator | Choose and guide Workers, supply context, review results, maintain work records, organize shared knowledge and report progress. It can handle clarification, synthesis and small self-contained actions itself. |
| Worker | Carry an assigned investigation or execution through to a result, contribute reusable findings and return a self-contained final AI message. |

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · User guide：1. You bring a goal to the Coordinator. It checks Workers and relevant project memory, including direct user activity in child conversations.
2. It chooses an existing Worker or creates one, supplies the goal and context, then updates `notes.md`.
3. As work changes, it uses **steer** to guide the current work or **queue** to leave an instruction for after the current turn. Interrupt and delete remain separate actions.
4. Each Worker turn automatically returns its complete last committed AI message. A turn without an AI message still reports its identity and outcome with an empty AI result.
5. The Coordinator reviews the result, follows up or concludes, and updates work records and reusable context. Normal closure waits for relevant work and result consumption within the same native Coordinator turn.
dsh-plugin-project-mode README · User guide：When you operate a Worker directly, the Coordinator can inspect its current state and read the conversation as needed when you return.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Project memory：```text
.dsh/project-mode/<project-id>/
├── notes.md                 Todos, assignments, progress, blockers, next steps
├── archived.md              Concluded work and its results
└── context/

The Coordinator maintains `notes.md` and `archived.md` so it knows where the project stands and what needs attention.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Project memory：Both the Coordinator and Workers maintain context. They read `context/context.md` first, then open the files needed for the current task. Workers contribute valuable reusable findings and update the index. The Coordinator primarily organizes, consolidates and prunes that knowledge. Routine progress stays in the work records.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Project memory：These documents persist with the project; they are loaded progressively rather than copied into every request. [The MOA model](docs/moa-architecture.md) describes these responsibilities in more detail.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Features in DSH：- Select **Project** for a new conversation before its first message. Its Project identity stays fixed after the first turn starts.
- Expand the Coordinator in the original workspace sidebar to open its Workers. Each has a stable identity icon and current status.
- Click a Worker capsule in the main conversation to open that child. Capsules stay with the conversation segment where work was dispatched, updated or received; later passive replies do not move them.
- Use the default **Workers** and **notes.md** tabs on the right. Workers shows a newest-first timeline of original input, final AI output and recorded artifacts. Each message shows up to two lines of text with an ellipsis for overflow; click the message to expand its original Markdown or collapse it. Both tabs are closable.
- Worker composers provide **Back** to the Coordinator and use native delegated permissions without an independent permission picker. Archiving the Project brings its managed Workers along.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Features in DSH：Coordinator delegation/control tools are replaced only in that Agent's scope. Workers and ordinary conversations retain native composition. Native Stop remains available and does not automatically stop every Worker.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Project structure：```text
packages/project-mode/
├── src/host/       Project lifecycle, Worker operations and result delivery
├── src/client/     Sidebar, capsules and project tabs
├── src/shared/     Shared types and contracts

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Development：Requires Node **24.9+**, npm and Git.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Burns1028/dsh-plugin-project-mode.git
cd dsh-plugin-project-mode
npm ci
node scripts/apply-native-compat.mjs --dry-run

`npm test` builds the plugin first. Edit `packages/project-mode/src`; regenerate the committed `lib` artifacts through the build. See [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) for typechecks, native contracts, package consumer verification and the test map.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · API and documentation：The Coordinator uses `control_workers` with `spawn`, `list`, `get`, `send`, `history`, `interrupt` and `delete`. `send` distinguishes current-work **steer** from next-turn **queue**. See the tool API for arguments, examples and result semantics.

dsh-plugin-project-mode README · Current limits：Delegation remains a model judgment. This preview does not guarantee ideal task ownership on every request, and does not use task keywords or command/time thresholds to force it.

Try Project Mode on a small project and share your workflow or installation feedback in [trial feedback](https://github.com/Burns1028/dsh-plugin-project-mode/issues/new?template=project-mode-trial.yml). If you would like to follow its development, a star helps others discover it.
